reason: policy: high-risk change (1 violation(s); require_approval by high_impact_paths)
summary: Click analytics per the approved impact analysis: click_events table (V2), best-effort click recording on redirect, private stats endpoint, click erasure on delete under a row lock
decisions: Deletion race: Click recording and deletion both take a PESSIMISTIC_WRITE lock on the link row (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE); recording only inserts if the link is not deleted (agent)
Failure isolation: ClickRecorder runs in its own transaction after the redirect lookup; RedirectController catches any RuntimeException from it and still returns the 302 (agent)
Existing API compatibility: resolveForRedirect(String) keeps its signature (now delegating to resolve(String)), so existing callers and tests keep working (agent)
Daily buckets: click_date is stored as the UTC day at write time; stats query days >= today-29 and zero-fill in Java, oldest first (agent)
Privacy: click_events holds only id, link_id, clicked_at, click_date; the request is never inspected for analytics (agent)
Migration: V2__create_click_events.sql adds the table, a foreign key to links and two indexes; V1 untouched. Verified by upgrading a real v1 database: existing links and tombstones unaffected (agent)
